content:
oncall-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty trigger received for service="inference-prod" — urgency=high — incident_id=PD-8742

pagerduty-bot: page fired to user(s): @kevin (oncall), @maria (backup) — binding: service_tag="prod-inference"; schedule="night-rotation" :alarm_clock:

kevin: ack'd — looking

maria: i just woke up, pulling logs now. did PD include a runbook?

kevin: runbook link in the PD notes points at `inference/latency-playbook` but the page text says "wrong service". this smells like routing tag mismatch.

charlie: hey — i'm seeing a flood of 503s from the auth-proxy -> inference gateway between 03:12-03:21 UTC. customer-facing error rate spiked ~6% on requests/sec.

alice: confirmed. traces show requests being retried and hit a fallback model which is throttled. initial spike at 03:12 caused autoscaler backoff.

maria: PD payload attached: `service: inference-prod`, `tags: ["stage:prod", "service:inference"]`, but our routing rule expects `service_tag: prod-inference` (dash vs dot).

kevin: oof — ops-rotation-bot recently applied an override for a contractor shadow schedule that uses `prod.inference` as the tag. looks like two tag formats in rotation metadata.

ops-rotation-bot: update: rotation apply: override `night-rotation` by user=jordan at 2026-03-15T02:58Z — added shadow schedule `shadow-night-ops` with tag `prod.inference` (note dot).

charlie: can we temporarily remap PD binding? if we patch a fallback to route `prod.inference` -> `prod-inference` the pages will reach the right oncall.

kevin: i'll rebind the PD service to include alias tags — doing a quick hotfix now.

kevin: command i ran: ```
# quick pd CLI patch
pd service edit PD-svc-inference --add-tag prod.inference --add-tag prod-inference
```

pagerduty-bot: Service update received — added tags `prod.inference`, `prod-inference`.

maria: pages stopped after ~03:18 UTC. rate of 503s reduced and retries dropped. looks like mitigation worked.

alice: customer impact window ~03:12-03:18 UTC. preliminary estimate: ~6 minutes of elevated errors for ~1.2% of requests overall. one customer reported delayed responses (support ticket #INC-3321).

charlie: root cause: rotation override introduced inconsistent service tag format (dot vs dash) causing PD routing to match wrong service binding and fall through to default service which paged contractor bucket.

maria: followups: 1) revert/normalize rotation metadata tags; 2) add PD validation to CI for tag format; 3) run a backfill check for other rotations using dotted tags.

kevin: ongoing: i'm rolling a config change to the ops-rotation system to enforce `prod-inference` format only. also opening a PD rule to treat "prod.inference" as alias for 30 days.

ops-rotation-bot: roll-out job queued: enforce_tag_format="dash" for rotation `night-rotation` — job id 7862.

alice: can we get a pager note for the incident? i'll draft a short blameless summary for postmortem.

maria: draft: "03:12 UTC — automated pages fired to wrong on-call due to inconsistent service tag format introduced by a rotation override. pages were remapped at 03:18 UTC which restored correct routing. Impact: transient 503 spike affecting a subset of customer traffic."

charlie: adding timeline items to incident doc and assigning follow-ups: ops (normalize tags), infra (PD CI check), devex (runbook tidy).

kevin: downscoped immediate action items: (a) PD alias for dotted tags (temporary), (b) enforce rotation tag format, (c) audit all rotation overrides last 90d for dotted tags.

maria: i'll create the support communication summarizing affected customers and expected follow-up.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if escalation occurred, file postmortem within 72h. No manual escalation observed.

alice: filing incident doc now — assigning to `inc-2026-03-15-pd-routing-tag-mismatch`. tagging cc: @sre, @devex, @prod.

charlie: postmortem owners assigned. moving to incident channel for follow-up. thanks everyone — good triage. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-8742 resolved by user=kevin at 2026-03-15T03:22Z (ack -> resolve).

maria: quick note for retrospec — can we add a lint to rotation PR template that rejects tags containing `.` in prod-* rotations? tiny change could save 10+ minutes next time.

kevin: agreed. i will put up the PR today.

alice: closing thread. we still have follow-ups but no active pages.
